0.2.0.lead: Own filters: put together what you want to see, and hide what you do not need.

sections.title: Own filters
sections.body: A filter gathers tasks by your conditions: open or completed, due today or in the next 7 days, completed today, from certain spaces or lists, marked, assigned to you or someone else, by priority or tag. All chosen conditions must match. Each filter has a name, colour and symbol and sits in the sidebar below the collections.

sections.title: The sidebar the way you like it
sections.body: The eye shows or hides each collection (Today, Scheduled, All and so on) and each own filter. It applies to all your devices, the iPhone app included.

sections.title: Many more symbols
sections.where: Edit a space, list or filter
sections.body: 259 symbols in groups instead of 46, with a search in English and German: “dog” finds the dog, “fridge” the fridge.

small: “There is a new version” only shows when there really is one.
With Today hidden, nextasks starts on the first collection still shown.

0.1.0.lead: nextasks is rebuilt: tasks for families and small groups, in the browser, installable as an app, and with an iPhone app.

sections.title: Collections, spaces and lists
sections.body: At the top the collections Today, Scheduled, All, Marked, Assigned to me and Completed, below them your spaces with their lists. A space you do not need can be hidden from its menu; it then counts nowhere until you show it again.

sections.title: Tasks and notes
sections.where: Click a task, or New task at the top
sections.body: A task opens as a card in the middle; the button at the end of its row shows it in a column on the right instead. Notes are written with bold, lists, checklists and pictures, without any marks to learn. A right click opens a menu wherever there is something to do.

sections.title: Together with others
sections.body: Invite family or friends to a space with a link or by mail and assign tasks to one or more people. One is enough: whoever completes it first completes it for everyone.

sections.title: Notifications and reports
sections.body: One table says what reaches you by mail, in the browser or on the iPhone: tasks assigned to you, tasks that are due, changes in lists you follow, and the reports “My day” and “Weekly report”.

small: Quick entry with Shift+N: “Milk tomorrow 9am #groceries !!” sets date, time, tag and priority.
Install nextasks as an app from the account menu; it says when there is a new version.
An API for programs (docs/api.md), columns per section, subtasks, repetitions in words, a trash for 30 days, light and dark.
